note: The board buyer's policy for the root of trust's own chain at Wafer L4 and Package/Test L4, so that the test house that provisions each unit is rated L4 in its own track, as Firmware L4 for the board asks: an independent lab inspects a seeded sample of the lot. Its design section is the PicoRV32 example's, since EXR-01's die is that design. The firmware block holds the root of trust firmware to Firmware L4: built isolated with the pinned Go toolchain, reviewed, in the buyer's release log, rebuilt bit for bit by an independent rebuilder, and approved by two people.

simulated.note: The example's manufacturing is simulated, so this policy accepts records made from simulated hardware. A policy for real parts leaves this out.

inspection.note: Wafer L4 and Package/Test L4 for the root of trust: a seeded sample by an independent lab accredited under ISO/IEC 17025, of at least two shipped units, with every metal layer and polysilicon imaged in the core and the register file.
